_comment: iMessage is a native macOS adapter (Messages.app + chat.db), NOT a web scraper, so the runner never runs CSS selectors against a DOM for this platform. The selector-test endpoint and the SelectorRegistry contract still require entries; setting them to '*' (a valid CSS selector that matches the document root) ensures `document.querySelectorAll('*')` returns a sensible count and never throws SyntaxError. Previously every entry was 'n/a' (invalid CSS), which broke selectorTest's evaluateSelectorCounts when an operator ran it against IMESSAGE.
